entire_full_affine_primal_reasoning_not_.statement: Full-affine global approximation from ABOVE with exact value at a prescribed rational point, for arbitrary ACTUAL REAL positive-growth PA reference on rational geometry.
entire_full_affine_primal_reasoning_not_.proof:
Work first on a single saturated rational affine d-space, translated so the prescribed rational point is zero. Let gamma be the ACTUAL continuous convex finite REAL PA reference on a finite rational carrier and gamma>=b|x|-B with b>0. Let f be any continuous convex function with |f-gamma|<=C. Write gamma=max_j(a_j.x+b_j) with actual REAL gradients and set h(x)=max_j a_j.x and Delta=conv{a_j}. Then |f-h| is bounded on the WHOLE space; Delta is a compact full-dimensional polytope, possibly with irrational vertices.
The recession cones of the finite rational carrying cells cover the whole vector space. To see coverage without an assumption on arbitrary carriers, on a ray tv choose an unbounded subsequence contained in one cell among the finitely many cells; its recession cone contains v. Positive growth makes every carrying cell pointed: a lineality direction would have opposite gamma recession slopes, which cannot both be strictly positive. On each recession cone, h equals the linear part of that cell. Choose finite rational ray generators r for all these cones. The cone E_h=epi(h) is EXACTLY generated by (r,h(r)) and the upward vertical ray: on each cone the graph height is linear, so its rational conic spatial decomposition lifts with equality. All heights may be REAL; spatial generators are rational. These are genuine finite polyhedral data, not a claim of a rational epigraph in d+1 coordinates.
The conjugate f*(p)=sup_x(p.x-f(x)) is finite on Delta, infinite outside Delta, convex and lower semicontinuous. On Delta, p.x<=h(x) gives a uniform upper bound and x=0 a finite lower bound. Outside Delta, strict separation gives a direction along which the supremum diverges. A finite lower-semicontinuous convex function g on a compact polytope is continuous EVEN ON ITS BOUNDARY: its values are bounded above by the largest vertex value. At a point x, choose a radius smaller than the finitely many positive inactive-inequality slacks divided by their covector norms. For nearby y in the polytope extend the ray xy to that radius to obtain z still in the polytope; active inequalities remain valid and inactive ones remain valid by the slack choice. Write y=(1-t)x+t z with t tending to zero. Convexity gives limsup g(y)<=g(x), and lower semicontinuity gives the reverse liminf. Degenerate affine spans are treated in their own space. This proves whole-polytope continuity without an unsupported boundary regularity assertion.
Since f is continuous, the defining supremum for f* can be taken over rational spatial x. For any eta>0, choose at each p in Delta a rational x giving p.x-f(x)>f*(p)-eta/2. Continuity of f* makes this inequality with error eta valid on a neighborhood of p. Compactness selects FINITELY many such rational samples A; append0. Then g_A(p)=max_{x in A}(p.x-f(x)) satisfies f*(p)-eta<=g_A(p)<=f*(p) on ALL Delta. Let
 E_A=conv{(x,f(x)):x in A}+E_h.
This is closed: its first summand is compact and the second a closed finitely generated polyhedral cone. It is a finite REAL polyhedron with rational SPATIAL generators. Its projection is the whole vector space and it is upward closed. It is contained in epi(f). Indeed convexity and the bound relative to h imply f(x+v)<=f(x)+h(v): otherwise convex secants along x+tv would force a recession slope greater than h(v), contradicting |f-h| bounded. Apply this inequality to convex combinations of the samples and each cone generator. Thus E_A=epi(F_A) for a finite convex function F_A>=f; it also contains the sample(0,a), so F_A(0)=f(0)=a EXACTLY.
Its conjugate is g_A on Delta and infinity outside, by the compact-hull support formula and the polar inequalities of E_h. The elementary biconjugate identity for finite continuous convex functions follows from separating a point below their closed epigraph; equivalently from their supporting affine minorants. Consequently conjugating the uniform inequalities on Delta gives f<=F_A<=f+eta on the WHOLE affine space. This is global uniform approximation, not merely compact convergence.
Every lower face of E_A has its height as a single affine function of the spatial coordinate. It is generated by subsets of the finitely many lifted sample vertices and cone rays, excluding the vertical ray. Its spatial projection is therefore the convex hull of rational sample positions plus the cone of rational ray positions. This is a RATIONAL polyhedron despite irrational heights. The projection is injective on the lower graph, so projected face intersections and shared-face incidences are preserved. There are finitely many lower faces; they give a finite rational spatial complex on which F_A is continuous REAL PA. Its convexity makes it printed-PC; F_A is bounded relative to the ACTUAL unchanged gamma. No maximum wall with irrational spatial position is declared primitive. This proves genuine finite primitive-sector approximants BEFORE assigning any MA to f. The construction includes the exact contact sample at any prescribed rational point after rational translation, and it uses neither coefficient rounding nor unbounded recession perturbation.

steps.statement: Continuous printed-PC on a book of complete affine planes with quotient-independent pages is exactly branchwise ordinary convexity and agreement on the entire common affine subspace.
steps.proof:
Let Q_1,...,Q_r be distinct complete rational affine d-planes with common rational affine intersection H, of dimension k with0<=k<d. Choose a rational v in H, translate v to zero, and use the same letter for the common linear subspace. Assume Q_i intersect Q_j=H and the sum of the quotient subspaces Q_i/H in the ambient quotient is DIRECT. In particular EVERY union of TWO distinct complete rational affine planes with nonempty intersection satisfies this hypothesis. For at least two pages arbitrary positive REAL constant weights give the actual effective balanced cycle sum_i c_i[Q_i]. Reference and all carrying complexes retain their rational affine geometry and saturated lattices.
Necessity of branch convexity uses the complete legal inherited-cell argument from the whole S282 clarification: rational local endpoints and barycentric centers in a feasible rational face are dense, same-cell PCC gives convexity on closed cells, a rational segment crosses finitely many rational faces at rational parameters, and nearby opposite rational endpoints in its incident cells forbid a downward kink. Continuity then passes rational segments to all real segments in each complete branch. The argument applies also to faces lying in H, since branch-endpoint splits are legal splits of X. There is no coarsening of the inherited carrier and no automatic continuity claim for arbitrary competitors. Agreement on H is single-valuedness.
Conversely suppose all branch functions f_i are convex and have the same restriction g on H. The restriction g is itself convex. A printed center x outside H is on one unique branch, and its incident endpoint cells all lie on it, so ordinary Jensen applies. At a center x in H, group the finitely many endpoints by branch; endpoints in H may be assigned to any branch containing them. Let A_i be the sum of its coefficients, ignoring zero groups. Modulo H the barycenter equation has independent branch components. Consequently EACH group's weighted transverse mean is zero. Its normalized mean y_i is in H. Branch convexity gives sum_{j in i}alpha_j f_i(x_j)>=A_i g(y_i). Since sum_i A_i y_i=x and sum_i A_i=1, convexity of g yields total cost>=g(x). This is valid for every REAL relation weight and rational refinement. The direct-sum assumption is in the QUOTIENT only; it is not a claim that the pages themselves have zero intersections. For three or more dependent quotient pages this sufficiency proof is unavailable.

steps.statement: Full-affine global upper approximation with finite exact contact samples; complete primal foundation included.
steps.proof:
The entire T3 proof below is included as working reasoning, not a grant inferred from a flag. The whole accepted S282 affine theorem with all clarifications independently supplies the same full-affine global REAL-reference domain result. Here we need its stronger explicit sample property and retain the complete primal derivation: choose finitely many rational primal samples covering the entire conjugate polytope, take their REAL lifted heights and the EXACT original recession epigraph cone, and project its lower faces to rational spatial geometry. The resulting actual finite REAL PA convex F_A satisfies f<=F_A<=f+eta globally.
Append any FINITE prescribed rational set B to those samples. Every added affine dual sample lies below f*, so the same uniform conjugate error survives. The epigraph hull lies inside epi(f) and contains each (b,f(b)); hence F_A(b)=f(b) EXACTLY for every b in B. This does not promise agreement on an infinite set. The entire original full-affine proof included below is sufficient to check separation, boundary dual continuity, finite selection, closedness, exact recession and rationality rather than merely cite its conclusion.

steps.statement: An ordinary convex extension lemma: a small upper approximation on ONE affine subspace extends with the SAME global error and EXACT recession.
steps.proof:
Work on one complete branch Q, translated so H is linear. Let f be continuous finite convex and boundedly relative to its ACTUAL convex finite REAL PA positive-growth reference gamma. Write h=gamma infinity and Delta=conv of its finite actual REAL gradients. Put phi=f*, a finite continuous convex function on the ENTIRE compact polytope Delta and infinity outside, as proved in the complete K2/T3 foundation. Let T:Q*->H* be restriction and Delta_H=T(Delta). For q in Delta_H define k(q)=min{phi(p):p in Delta,Tp=q}. Each fibre is compact and nonempty, so its minimum is attained. This projected function is convex; sequential compactness of Delta and lower semicontinuity of phi prove it lower semicontinuous. Extend it by infinity outside Delta_H. Its conjugate on H is
 k*(x)=sup_{p in Delta}(p(x)-phi(p))=f(x), x in H.
The elementary closed-convex biconjugate identity therefore identifies k=(f|H)*. It is finite and continuous on the whole polytope Delta_H by the whole boundary continuity proof. The k=0 dimensional case is the singleton-domain scalar identity.
Let g be continuous finite convex on H with f|H<=g<=f|H+eta and the SAME restriction recession h|H; g may be genuinely finite REAL PA, but the extension lemma itself does not require PA. Its conjugate b=g* is finite continuous on exactly Delta_H and satisfies k-eta<=b<=k there. Define the compact sets
 Gamma_phi={(p,phi(p)):p in Delta},
 S={(p,b(Tp)):p in Delta,phi(p)=k(Tp)}.
Continuity of phi,k,b on their whole compact polytopes makes S closed/compact; it contains at least one minimizing p in EVERY fibre. Let
 E=conv(Gamma_phi union S)+R_nonnegative(0,1).
The compact hull plus the vertical ray is closed; projection is Delta, and its lower boundary psi is a finite closed convex function on Delta. Since every source height is >=phi(p)-eta, the convex epigraph of phi-eta contains E. Because Gamma_phi is included, psi<=phi. Thus phi-eta<=psi<=phi. Likewise every source height is >=b(Tp), so the convex epigraph of b composed with T contains E and psi(p)>=b(Tp). On each fibre a source point from S has height EXACTLY b(q). Consequently min_{Tp=q}psi(p)=b(q), with an actual attained minimum, not a formal infimum exchange.
Set F=psi*. Conjugating phi-eta<=psi<=phi yields f<=F<=f+eta on ALL Q, and F has the exact same recession h because its dual domain remains Delta. For x in H, group the supremum by fibres:
 F(x)=sup_{q in Delta_H}(q(x)-min_{Tp=q}psi(p))=b*(x)=g(x).
This is an ACTUAL finite continuous convex extension, globally close and EXACT on the entire subspace H. F may have nonrational walls or fail to be PA; it is not declared primitive and receives NO MA. The next unit gives a genuine finite rational-geometry PA extension when g is finite PA. Only ordinary finite convex separation/compactness is used; no operator, envelope or all-PC density theorem is assumed in the extension lemma.

steps.statement: The convex extension can be made finite REAL PA on rational geometry while preserving the ENTIRE finite-PA shared restriction.
steps.proof:
Suppose g in K3 is continuous convex finite REAL PA on a finite rational carrier of H and boundedly relative to gamma|H. Its carrying cells are pointed by positive recession growth. Choose finitely many rational base vertices and rational recession rays of all those cells. Its epigraph in H is generated by the REAL lifted vertices(b,g(b)), lifted rays(r,h(r)) and the vertical ray, cell by cell. All its recession rays belong to the ORIGINAL epigraph cone E_h of the branch Q, with exact heights h(r)=h|H(r).
Apply the complete K2/T3 primal upper approximation to the intermediate convex F on Q with global error eta, appending ALL the finitely many g-carrier vertices as exact samples. This gives finite rational-geometry REAL PA convex F_A with F<=F_A<=F+eta globally. Its epigraph contains every appended lifted g vertex and the entire original E_h, so it contains ALL epi(g) on H by the cell generator representation. Hence F_A|H<=g. On the other hand F_A>=F and F|H=g imply F_A|H>=g. Therefore F_A|H=g EXACTLY on the WHOLE subspace, not merely at its vertices. Globally f<=F_A<=f+2eta. The same ACTUAL branch reference and exact recession are retained. This uses upper approximation of F and the full epigraph cone; interpolation on intersection vertices alone would not justify agreement between them. Rational projected lower faces prove true primitive membership despite REAL heights and coefficients. No measure is assigned to the possibly non-PA intermediate F.

steps.statement: Global decreasing REAL regularization of EVERY continuous-PC relative endpoint and EVERY C_b actual envelope on the common-subspace book.
steps.proof:
Let f be continuous printed-PC on the book X with |f-gamma|<=C. K1 gives convex f_i and common convex f_H on H. The ACTUAL reference restrictions gamma_i are finite convex REAL PA on rational geometry, and gamma_H is the same function on H, with positive growth there if k>0. Use the complete K2/T3 construction on H to choose finite rational-geometry REAL PA convex g_n with f_H<=g_n<=f_H+eta_n, eta_n=2^-n, same exact recession gamma_H infinity. For k=0 take the exact scalar f(v) instead. No operator on H is needed.
For EACH branch apply K3 to extend g_n to a continuous convex intermediate F_i within eta_n ABOVE f_i. Then apply K4 to obtain genuine finite REAL PA convex q_i,n with f_i<=q_i,n<=f_i+2eta_n globally and restriction EXACTLY g_n on all H. Refine the branch rational complexes together with the finite carrier of g_n on H; rational equations make H a union of common faces, and the induced carriers on H have a finite common rational refinement. Distinct pages meet exactly along H, so their carriers give a finite rational complex on X. The q_i,n glue continuously; K1 supplies every printed-PC inequality, not just those at the origin. They are boundedly relative to the SAME ACTUAL gamma on all branches.
Define q_n on X from those glued branches and G_n=q_n+4eta_n. K1 still applies because every common restriction shifts by the same constant. Uniformly on ALL X,
 4eta_n<=G_n-f<=6eta_n,
 G_{n+1}-f<=3eta_n<4eta_n<=G_n-f.
Thus G_n is genuinely finite REAL PA PC on rational geometry, globally uniformly decreasing to f, with one uniform bound relative to the ACTUAL unchanged gamma. This proves genuine GLOBAL real completion membership BEFORE the raw mixed operator is applied.
For ANY u in C_b(X), including arbitrary non-PA or nonseparable obstacles, the ENTIRE R230 grant with every clarification gives its actual unrestricted envelope f=P_gamma(u) continuous-PC and |f-gamma|<=||u||. Apply this global construction to that actual f, then the ENTIRE S272 genuine completed-domain theorem assigns its finite positive Radon raw MA and common actual mass. No compact/local obstacle approximation or raw finite-valued-PC automatic continuity is presumed. Positive arbitrary REAL page weights are retained. This proves universal all-C_b real envelope regularity for the stated book geometry, including TWO complete planes meeting in any rational proper affine subspace.

steps.statement: Crossing contact failure and exact new scope, not a complete original classification.
steps.proof:
For r>=2 choose a rational center v in H, one complete tangent page Q_1-v with weight c_1, and a rational line L in Q_2-v outside Q_1-v. The tangent cycle is the full positive sum of incident complete pages, and subtracting c_1[Q_1-v] leaves an explicitly effective BALANCED residual. The ENTIRE accepted S282 transverse-subcycle theorem with its inherited-carrier/source/historical clarifications applies. It proves a rational homogeneous flat jet h=sum_j|ell_j| with ell_j restricting to a saturated dual basis on Q_1-v and annihilating L, strictly saturated raw atom at least c_1 2^d d!, then uses the SAME ACTUAL REAL-reference S272 realization and finite-PA roof to give a bounded genuine PA obstacle with exact strictly negative contact integral. All endpoints here are finite genuine relative PA before the operator. K5 additionally proves all-C_b domain membership, so this is a sector in which universal regularity and contact failure coexist.
The positive-dimensional overlap theorem is NEW UNREVIEWED working mathematics. It covers finitely many complete equal-dimensional rational affine pages sharing ONE common rational affine subspace, with independent quotient spaces; in particular ANY TWO intersecting complete rational affine d-planes. It does not cover arbitrary families of dependent quotient pages, several distinct positive-dimensional overlaps, general polyhedral singular fans, products with several branching factors or abstract compact/glued spaces. A single-subspace convex dual lowering gives no simultaneous extension theorem for several overlaps: lowering a fibre minimum for one restriction may violate the conjugate lower bounds required by another. The K3 source set is therefore not extrapolated to arbitrary intersection arrangements.
The whole S282 mathematical grant is assumed ONLY with all clarifications and native215 overall historical-INCONCLUSIVE retained. Its whole mathematical/source review is not automatic or canonical acceptance. The other WHOLE grants A224/B225/R230/S262/S272 retain all their limits; old287's complete primal reasoning is included only as freshly checked working proof, not a separate theorem grant. Literal PA_Z and the noncompact S262 exclusions remain separate, and no excluded endpoint is measured. Original P05.1/P05.2 complete structural classifications remain OPEN.
